operating_point.rationale: Chosen on the VALIDATION split only (802 encounters, 109 positive), never on test. Selected the highest threshold whose validation sensitivity still reaches the 70% target; that is 0.417586, achieving 0.706 sensitivity on validation and flagging 42.6% of validation encounters. Sensitivity is the constrained quantity and specificity is what is spent to buy it, because a missed deterioration is not recoverable by the next observation round whereas a false flag costs a clinician a bedside look. The 70% target and the resulting alert rate are a judgement call about alarm burden, not an optimum -- docs/metric-rationale.md sets out the reasoning and risk-log.yaml R-01 tracks the alarm-fatigue consequence.
